features.name: group1_ordinal_sum
features.description: Sum of the first ordinal block (a1-a5), capturing aggregate level on the 1-5 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth additive projection useful for linear margin separation.

features.name: group2_ordinal_sum
features.description: Sum of the second ordinal block (a6-a10), capturing aggregate level on the 1-5 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth additive projection useful for linear margin separation.

features.name: ordinal_block_diff
features.description: Signed difference between the two ordinal blocks, measuring asymmetry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed linear contrast feature SVMs can weight directly.

features.name: ordinal_block_abs_diff
features.description: Absolute discrepancy between matched ordinal positions across the two blocks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity measure of block disagreement for linear models.
features.formula: np.abs(a1 - a6) + np.abs(a2 - a7) + np.abs(a3 - a8) + np.abs(a4 - a9) + np.abs(a5 - a10)

features.name: log_continuous_block1_sum
features.description: Log1p-transformed sum of the first continuous block (a11-a15) to compress heavy tails.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths heavy-tailed inputs for stable linear/SVM weighting.

features.name: log_continuous_block2_sum
features.description: Log1p-transformed sum of the second continuous block (a16-a20) to compress heavy tails.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths heavy-tailed inputs for stable linear/SVM weighting.

features.name: continuous_block_ratio
features.description: Ratio of continuous block sums (block1 over block2), clipped to a stable range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative magnitude between blocks as a smooth projectable score.

features.name: continuous_log_abs_diff
features.description: Sum of log-scale absolute differences between paired continuous attributes across blocks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Robust severity measure of cross-block deviation for linear separation.
features.formula: np.abs(np.log1p(a11) - np.log1p(a16)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a12) - np.log1p(a17)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a13) - np.log1p(a18)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a14) - np.log1p(a19)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a15) - np.log1p(a20))

features.name: ordinal_monotonicity_score
features.description: Counts how many adjacent ordinal pairs are non-decreasing within block 1, normalized to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes structural monotonicity as a smooth normalized score.

features.name: tail_magnitude_indicator
features.description: Average log magnitude of the heaviest-tailed continuous attributes (a15 and a20).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable extreme-value indicator beneficial for linear margins.

features.name: ordinal_continuous_alignment
features.description: Semantic assessment of how well the ordinal block levels align with the continuous block magnitudes; computed as correlation-style alignment between normalized ordinal mean and normalized log continuous mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cross-block coherence as a smooth bounded judgment score for SVM.

features.name: row_dispersion_judgment
features.description: Holistic semantic judgment of within-row heterogeneity across all 20 attributes; high values indicate diverse profile, low values indicate uniform profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth bounded dispersion judgment complements linear features for margin shaping.
